title: Rising Tide Explorers

services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Join active local biologists for an adventure through the Rookery Bay Reserve at the start of the 10,000 islands. Paddle to beautiful mangrove tunnels, teeming mudflats, and intricate oyster reefs while searching for amazing wildlife like sea stars, large snails, birds, dolphin and manatee! Have your choice of single or tandem kayak for the journey. Tandem kayaks are great for families with small children. Conditions vary, and usually consist of calm, waist-deep water and sunshine! Perfect for the first-time paddler and the pro. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Explore the protected waters of Rookery Bay Reserve on guided eco boat tours near Naples and Marco Island. Led by local biologist captains, our boat tours visit some of Southwest Florida’s most unique coastal habitats, from bird rookeries and mangrove estuaries to secluded bays, shelling beaches, and historic island landscapes. Head out of Shell Island Road and experience evening in the estuary with one of our biologist guides! Watch hundreds of birds return to rest for the night on Rookery Bay’s famous bird rookery island!
